description: This file defines the ViewSupportController class within the OrangeHRM Help module, extending an abstract Vue controller. It sets up a Vue component called 'view-support' in the preRender method.

classes.name: ViewSupportController
classes.description: A controller class that extends AbstractVueController to set up the 'view-support' Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes a new 'view-support' component and assigns it for rendering.
